name: Nugget Slug
summary: Tool buckets at the Sludge Fen hold nugget slugs the Venture Company uses in its heavy equipment. Tinkerers seek the seventeen-point-five-gauge fasteners for work on volatile machinery.

sections.title: Industrial Fasteners of the Sludge Fen
sections.body: At the Venture Company’s extraction sites, nugget slugs fasten heavy equipment. They are made for demanding industrial assemblies and sized at seventeen-point-five gauge. Ordinary trade brings them little use. Yet tinkerers need them for custom goblin hardware.

sections.title: Tinkering with the Samophlange
sections.body:
Wenikee Boltbucket needs many nugget slugs to overhaul an unstable samophlange recovered from the Barrens. Tool buckets lie scattered across the Venture Company’s drilling operations at the Sludge Fen, making salvage lucrative for scavengers.

Wenikee’s repairs end in sudden failure. The samophlange explodes as she works.

faq.answer: A nugget slug is a seventeen-point-five-gauge metallic fastener used in heavy machinery. These fasteners hold together complex mechanisms such as oil drills and samophlanges.

aliases: where do i find nugget slugs
faq.answer: Nugget slugs are kept in tool buckets scattered around the Sludge Fen, a Venture Company drilling camp in the northeastern Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Wenikee Boltbucket need them?
faq.answer: Wenikee Boltbucket wants to tinker with and repair a samophlange recovered from the Barrens. She has run out of seventeen-point-five-gauge fasteners, so she sends adventurers to salvage more from the nearby Venture Company camp.

faq.q: Does using the nugget slugs fix the samophlange?
faq.answer: No. Wenikee fits the samophlange with the salvaged slugs and begins maintenance. Then it detonates in front of her.

angles.text: For an engineer, proprietary seventeen-point-five-gauge hardware is a poor match for an unstable goblin-engineered samophlange. Expect a rapid, explosive dismantling.
